users.title: Users & permissions
users.description: Manage accounts, roles and markings: roles grant actions, markings reveal sensitive properties.
users.selfRole: You cannot change your own role

create.description: Without an initial password a one-time temporary password is generated; the user must change it on first sign-in.
create.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate a temporary password

secret.warning: This password is shown only once and cannot be viewed again after closing. Share it through a secure channel.

markings.description: Saving replaces all of the user's current markings.
markings.hint: Users need a marking to see properties tagged with it, e.g. PII, FINANCE

reset.title: Reset the password of {name}?
reset.description: A one-time temporary password is generated and the user's sessions are revoked.

delete.title: Delete user {name}?
delete.description: The account can no longer sign in. This cannot be undone.

health.title: System health
health.description: Free-tier usage, degraded dependencies, dead-letter queues and graph projection maintenance.
health.usageChartAria: Bar chart of today's free-tier usage per resource; dashed line marks 80%
health.degradedCount: {count, plural, one {# dependency} other {# dependencies}} degraded
health.genericDegraded: This dependency is unavailable; related features run in degraded mode.

neo4j.name: Neo4j graph database
neo4j.degraded: Deep traversal (3+ hops) is unavailable; exploration falls back to D1 (up to 2 hops).

llm.name: LLM provider
llm.degraded: AI recommendations are unavailable; rule-based suggestions only.
llm.fallback: The primary model is unavailable; AI recommendations use the fallback {value}.

realtime.name: Realtime stream
realtime.degraded: Realtime push is unavailable; clients poll instead.

kv.name: KV cache
kv.degraded: Cache unavailable; reads hit the database and may be slower.

queues.name: Queues
queues.degraded: Queues unavailable; background jobs are delayed.

dlq.title: Dead-letter queues
dlq.subtitle: Messages that failed after retries; replay once the cause is fixed
dlq.confirmSelectedTitle: Replay {count, plural, one {# selected message} other {# selected messages}}?
dlq.confirmAllTitle: Replay all {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} in {queue}?

dlq.replayed: Replayed {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}

graph.title: Graph projection
graph.subtitle: Objects and links mirrored into Neo4j
graph.description: If Neo4j diverges from D1 (e.g. after restoring the instance), rebuild the projection from D1. The rebuild runs in the background.
graph.confirmDescription: All projected objects are re-queued into Neo4j; deep traversal may be incomplete meanwhile.
graph.queued: Queued {count, plural, one {# object} other {# objects}} for projection
